newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Tuesday amid squaring of short positions but fresh selling by individuals wiped out some of the early gains, dealers said.
"The index may rise again on Wednesday on short-covering but sentiment would remain mixed to bearish amid lack of support from institutional investors," one dealer said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 7.84 points, or 0.51 percent, to end at 1,532.87. Gainers led losers 125 to 122. Turnover rose to 64 million shares from 50 million in the previous session.

Bank of Punjab rose 1.10 rupees to 24.85. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.25 to 35.70. PTCL fell 0.50 to 26.20. Hub Power Co rose 0.45 to 36.65 and Shell Pakistan 7.50 to 234.50. ICI Pakistan fell 0.05 to 22.65.
